english.title: Knowingly cause / allow false document to be produced - immigration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with a view to obtaining

(A)_[for yourself]_
(B)_[for another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

support under any provision made by or under Part VI of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999, knowingly caused or allowed to be produced or given to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person exercising functions under Part VI of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999, a document or information which you knew to be false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 105(1) and (2) of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
